device_challenge.title: Ask a device for proof
device_challenge.description: Mints a nonce for a device to sign. Public by necessity: proving a device is how a session is first obtained, so there is no session to check. A signed-out device is answered exactly as an unknown one, and the answer is a redacted projection that never names the subject.

device_verify.title: Spend a device challenge
device_verify.description: Checks an Ed25519 signature over the nonce against the device's registered key and mints a session. Every way the proof can be wrong is one refusal, so a caller is never told which.

recovery_request.title: Begin a recovery
recovery_request.description: Mints a recovery challenge for a phone number. Whether the secret is echoed back is the mounting process's dev-only choice and is withheld by default.

recovery_verify.title: Complete a recovery
recovery_verify.description: Spends a recovery challenge, mints a session, and ends every other device the subject held.

operator_signin.title: Sign in to an operator console
operator_signin.description: Verifies an address and password and mints a session. An address that holds no credential answers byte-for-byte as a wrong password, including the attempt counter, so the refusal never says which addresses are real.

operator_password_change.title: Change an operator password
operator_password_change.description: Replaces the caller's own verifier. It does not clear a lock-out, because a password change is not proof that the guesser has gone.

operator_credential_disable.title: Withdraw an operator credential
operator_credential_disable.description: Withdraws access in place and idempotently, keeping the instant access first ended rather than moving it forward.

operator_credential_list.title: List a subject's operator credentials
operator_credential_list.description: Every credential a subject holds, withdrawn ones included: a withdrawn credential is part of the record of who could once sign in.

verification_set.title: Record a verification decision
verification_set.description: Sets a subject's standing as checked by a reviewer. The instant is stamped by the store and never honoured from the caller.

phone_salt_list.title: List the phone-hashing salts
phone_salt_list.description: Every salt version, newest first, without any secret.
